name: Unblocked partial-pivot LU factorization and dense linear solve
description: Factor a square real matrix using LAPACK DGETF2 partial pivoting, solve one right-hand side, and return packed LU, LAPACK-style 1-based pivot indices, residual infinity norm and scaled backward error.

provenance.metadata_source: public GitHub repository API, observed this mining round
provenance.reference_values: The available upstream DGESV example uses rand() and has no fixed golden outputs, so none are falsely attributed to it. Frozen factors/pivots were generated by compiling the exact pinned upstream DGETF2 C translation with an explicit small scalar BLAS/platform shim. Triangular solutions are derived from those native factors; separate known-solution and reconstruction properties verify the wrapper. Original Fortran was not compiled.

budget.enforcement: Raw CLI byte limit and POSIX alarm; strict schema, finite values and nesting checks; MCP subprocess killed/reaped after 10 seconds. One active calculation. Not a hostile-code sandbox.

limitations: Dense square systems only, order 1..64, one RHS, no sparse solver, condition estimate, refinement or singular least-squares fallback. Exact zero pivots are rejected; a tiny nonzero pivot is not evidence of a well-conditioned problem. Small residual/backward error does not guarantee small forward error. Arrays must have consistent dimensions.
port_notes: Ports the unblocked DGETF2 pivot choice, whole-row swaps, multipliers and rank-one trailing update from the bundled LAPACK Fortran, with its generated C translation as native verification source. Element-wise division avoids reciprocal overflow for subnormal pivots, matching the source safe-minimum fallback. A conventional pivot application and forward/back substitution wrapper is added for one RHS. This does not port blocked DGETRF or optimized BLAS. The selected subdirectory LAPACK BSD license, including its patent-reassurance disclaimer, controls these files and is preserved in full.
